source_title: NBA Rule 1 court diagram. The rule TEXT says only 'A free throw lane shall be marked at each end of the court with dimensions and markings as shown on the court diagram' -- the number is in the picture. Read off the diagram: '16 FEET (INSIDE)' dimensioned across the lane, on the same drawing as 'LENGTH 94 FEET (inside)' and 'WIDTH 50 FEET (OUTSIDE)'. Read 2026-08-07.
